Two youths stabbed outside Delhi liquor shop, one dead

A man was stabbed to death and another injured following an altercation at a liquor shop in Delhi's Kanhaiya Nagar. Police reported that the incident occurred after a fight between individuals. The injured man is currently receiving medical treatment at a hospital. Authorities are investigating the incident.
